description: Returns the largest value in a set of values. Does not ignore logical values and text.

params.description: Up to 255 values (number, text, logical value) for which the largest value will be returned.The first argument is required, subsequent arguments are optional. Arguments can be numbers, logical values and text representations of numbers, names, ranges, or arrays.
params.name: args
params.type: number | string | boolean | (number | string | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName

signature: MAXA(args: number | string | boolean | (number | string | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName): number
